18.headline: Durham buries the 1 seed with a 33-16 fourth quarter
18.dek: The Destroyers pulled within a game of first, Jokić hung 26-22-17 on helpless Manhattan, Curry torched Waltham with nine 3-pointers, and Stony Brook got flattened again.

games.text: For three quarters this was the game of the year: 16 lead changes, tied at 95, the 1 seed and the 2 seed trading haymakers. Then Durham outscored Ithaca 33-16 in the fourth and it became a mugging. Alperen Şengün bullied his way to 29 points on 11-of-14 shooting, Austin Reaves matched him with 29 and Anthony Davis added 26. Luka Dončić technically had a triple-double; he also bricked 15 of his 21 shots, nine of them from three. Durham has won four straight and trails Ithaca by one game for the 1 seed.

Nikola Jokić had 26 points, 22 rebounds and 17 assists, which is less a stat line than a hostile takeover. Queens never trailed, led by 25 and crushed Manhattan 123-102, vaulting from the 7 seed to the 5 seed and level with the 4 seed on record. The Elephants scored 16 points in the second quarter, a number Jokić had beaten in rebounds by the end. Manhattan is 6-12, the 10 seed, and running out of things to blame.

Rochester showed up missing Jimmy Butler, Ja Morant and Josh Hart, so Stephen Curry simply shot until Waltham stopped moving. He drilled nine 3-pointers, scored 37, and the Dragons led by 22 on the way to a 133-121 win that keeps them the 4 seed. Waltham got blown off its own floor for a third straight loss and has tumbled from the 5 seed to the 7 seed. Cade Cunningham handed out 12 assists and missed all five of his 3-pointers, a generous night in both directions.

Stony Brook's leading scorers had 15 points each, which would be a fine total for one of them in a half. Cambridge hammered the Stingrays 115-92 behind Jaylen Brown's 30 and Victor Wembanyama's 24 points and 14 rebounds, leading by as many as 28 without Rudy Gobert. The Platypuses hold the 3 seed at 11-7. Stony Brook has lost four straight and sunk to the 9 seed, where the water is cold and nobody visits.

Gooning led by 17, relaxed, and then spent the fourth quarter remembering why it is the Gooners. Toronto ripped off a 34-23 final period and still lost 113-109, because Shai Gilgeous-Alexander had already dropped 30 and the hole was too deep. That is three straight wins for Gooning, which climbs past Stony Brook into the 8 seed. Kawhi Leonard scored 29 on six 3-pointers for the Jays, who stay the 6 seed and should consider starting games earlier.
